# Estate files reference

The files of an estate test suite: the map `driftbench estate scan` writes and a person approves, the plan `estate plan` writes, and the phrase bank and session index that sit beside the map for `estate generate`. See [estate](../estate.md). The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are as written below, some in camelCase. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## EstateMap

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | yes |  | Map format version, always 1. |
| `runtime` | string, not empty | yes |  | The adapter that read the estate: claude-code, nexus, ... |
| `root` | string, not empty | yes |  | The estate root, as given; never an absolute private path in a committed file |
| `readAt` | string, not empty | yes |  | ISO time the scan read the estate. |
| `documents` | list of [DocumentInfo](#documentinfo) | no |  | Document authority and non-normative line spans; absent in older maps. |
| `atoms` | list of [Atom](#atom) | yes |  | Every atom the scan read from the estate. |
| `edges` | list of [Edge](#edge) | yes |  | The edges of the estate graph, decided by code. |
| `space` | string | no |  | Path of the exported space map of the situation axes |
| `ignore` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | Globs the scan skipped beside the runtime defaults; lint reads the estate with them again |
| `followedLinks` | list of strings, each not empty | no |  | Links, relative to the estate root, that the scan read through to a real path outside the root |
| `producedBy` | [EstateMap producedBy](#estatemap-producedby) | no |  | Who proposed the model atoms; code atoms say producedBy: code on the atom itself |
| `hash` | string, not empty | yes |  | SHA-256 over the sorted atom hashes and edges |

## Atom

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string, not empty | yes |  | Stable id: kind, file and a slug of the quote |
| `kind` | [AtomKind](#atomkind) | yes |  | The kind of place the atom comes from, which sets its mandatory test types. |
| `title` | string, not empty | yes |  | One line in plain words |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](#provenance) | yes |  | Where the atom is read from: file, line span, quote and hash. |
| `producedBy` | `code` or `model` | yes |  | Code when read from file structure and approved as read; model when split from prose by a model. |
| `role` | `axis` or `detail` | no | `axis` | Axis puts the atom in the space map as a target; detail keeps it for the generator only. |
| `approved` | boolean | no | `false` | Whether the atom is approved; only approved atoms enter the space map and the plan. |
| `situation` | string | no |  | When the atom applies, in words; empty means always |
| `evidence` | list of [EvidencePredicate](#evidencepredicate), at least 1 item | yes |  | What a trace shows when the atom is obeyed, as at least one typed predicate. |
| `enforcement` | list of strings | no | `[]` | Ids of guards or tests that already check it; empty means trusted |
| `fields` | map of string to any value | no |  | Kind-specific structure read by code: a guard event, a tool schema, a brief field list |

## AtomKind

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `instruction` | A rule of the estate: an obligation or a prohibition with its situation, split from prose by a model. |
| `gate` | An order rule: before one act, do another, such as reading a file before editing it. |
| `route` | A trigger: an ask of one class loads a named skill or helper. |
| `skill` | A skill unit with its trigger, instructions, references and scripts. |
| `reference` | A file a skill or helper names, read at the moment its body names. |
| `script` | An executable a skill ships, with its inputs and outputs. |
| `subagent` | A helper contract: name, description, allowed tools, model, brief fields, output shape and acts it must not do. |
| `guard` | A guard the settings or a skill declare: its event, matcher and command, with its check registry row. |
| `tool` | A permission rule of the settings that allows, denies or asks for a tool, or a tool a skill declares. |
| `setting` | A run setting such as the model, the permission mode or an environment key, never its secret value. |
| `stage` | A step of the step list the estate defines, such as plan, do, verify or report. |
| `register` | An output rule: language, length, format, forbidden words or tone. |
| `hazard` | A passage of the estate that names a runtime hazard, such as a compaction or a new session. |
| `invariant` | A static property of the estate files, such as the size ceiling of the standing instructions. |

## EvidencePredicate

Write one of these forms.

* a mapping with `type: skill_loaded`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: skill_not_loaded`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: guard`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: tool_called`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: tool_not_called`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: reference_not_read`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: subagent_not_dispatched`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: guard_not_fired`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: stage_not_reached`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: artifact_not_created`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: file_not_written`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: ordered`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: stage_reached`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: workspace`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: artifact`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: text`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: static`, with the fields below
* a mapping with `type: custom`, with the fields below

With `type: skill_loaded`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `skill_loaded` | yes |  | This form holds when the named skill loads in the block. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The skill name the trace records on its load. |
| `min` | integer, at least 1 | no |  | The fewest loads that count; defaults to 1. |

With `type: skill_not_loaded`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `skill_not_loaded` | yes |  | This form holds when the named skill never loads in the block. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The skill name that must not load. |

With `type: guard`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `guard` | yes |  | This form holds when the named guard records a decision in the trace. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The guard name its decision records carry, such as its script file name. |
| `verdict` | string, not empty | no |  | Without it, any verdict counts, as in the guards check |
| `min` | integer, at least 0 | no |  | The fewest decisions that count; defaults to 1. |

With `type: tool_called`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `tool_called` | yes |  | This form holds when the agent calls the tool. |
| `label` | string, not empty | yes |  | The tool label as the trace records it, such as Read or Bash. |
| `input` | map of string to any value | no |  | Input fields one call must match; without it, any call of the tool counts. |
| `min` | integer, at least 1 | no |  | The fewest matching calls that count; defaults to 1. |

With `type: tool_not_called`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `tool_not_called` | yes |  | This form holds when the agent never calls the tool. |
| `label` | string, not empty | yes |  | The tool label that must not appear in the trace. |
| `input` | map of string to any value | no |  | Only forbid calls matching these input assertions; without it, forbid every call. |

With `type: reference_not_read`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `reference_not_read` | yes |  | No successful read of this path or glob in the block. |
| `path` | string, not empty | yes |  | The path or glob of the reference that must not be read. |

With `type: subagent_not_dispatched`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `subagent_not_dispatched` | yes |  | No dispatch of this helper in the block. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The name of the helper that must not be dispatched. |

With `type: guard_not_fired`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `guard_not_fired` | yes |  | No firing of this guard in the block. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The name of the guard that must not fire. |
| `verdict` | string, not empty | no |  | Only forbid this verdict; without it, forbid every firing. |

With `type: stage_not_reached`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `stage_not_reached` | yes |  | This stage never appears in the block. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The name of the stage that must not be reached. |

With `type: artifact_not_created`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `artifact_not_created` | yes |  | The workspace diff lists no creation of this path or glob. |
| `path` | string, not empty | yes |  | The path or glob that must not be created. |

With `type: file_not_written`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `file_not_written` | yes |  | The workspace diff lists no creation or change of this path or glob. |
| `path` | string, not empty | yes |  | The path or glob that must not be created or changed. |

With `type: ordered`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `ordered` | yes |  | This form holds when the before act comes earlier than the after act. |
| `before` | string, not empty | yes |  | A tool label, a skill name or a stage name |
| `after` | string, not empty | yes |  | A tool label, a skill name or a stage name that must come second. |

With `type: stage_reached`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `stage_reached` | yes |  | This form holds when the run reaches the named stage. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The stage name from the step list of the estate. |

With `type: workspace`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `workspace` | yes |  | This form holds when the workspace changes as listed. |
| `created` | list of strings | no |  | Paths the run creates in the workspace. |
| `changed` | list of strings | no |  | Paths the run changes in the workspace. |
| `deleted` | list of strings | no |  | Paths the run deletes from the workspace. |
| `othersUntouched` | boolean | no |  | When true, every path not listed stays untouched. |

With `type: artifact`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `artifact` | yes |  | This form holds when the run produces a file at the path. |
| `path` | string, not empty | yes |  | Workspace path of the produced file. |
| `kind` | string | no |  | File kind: xlsx, docx, pptx, pdf, csv, json, text or code; the generator drops any other value. |

With `type: text`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `text` | yes |  | This form holds when the reply text meets its word and language rules. |
| `must` | list of strings | no |  | Literal words the reply must contain. |
| `mustNot` | list of strings | no |  | Literal words the reply must not contain. |
| `lang` | string | no |  | Language tag the reply is written in, such as EN. |

With `type: static`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `static` | yes |  | This form holds when a property of the estate files holds, with no run. |
| `check` | string, not empty | yes |  | A property of the estate files, no run |

With `type: custom`:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `custom` | yes |  | This form names a check that decides the evidence, run by code or judged. |
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The check name, such as ordered, max_words or grounded_values. |
| `options` | map of string to any value | no |  | Options passed to the named check, such as a word limit. |

## Edge

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string, not empty | yes |  | Id of the atom the edge starts at. |
| `to` | string, not empty | yes |  | Id of the atom the edge ends at, or an event node on an event edge. |

## EdgeKind

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `route` | A route atom to the skill or helper it loads. |
| `reference` | A skill or helper to a file its body names. |
| `script` | A skill to a script it ships. |
| `dispatch` | A skill or helper to a helper its body names. |
| `enforces` | A guard to a rule it checks. |
| `event` | A guard to the event node it runs on. |
| `allows` | A skill or helper to a tool or skill it may use. |
| `next` | A stage to the stage that follows it. |
| `cites` | A rule to a rule its words name by label. |

## EstateMap producedBy

Who proposed the model atoms; code atoms say producedBy: code on the atom itself

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `family` | string, not empty | yes |  | The model family that split the prose, `code` when no model ran |
| `model` | string, not empty | yes |  | The model that split the prose, or unknown when the model port names none. |
| `at` | string matching `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\d\|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d(?:\.\d+)?(?:Z))$` | yes |  | ISO time of the scan, the same as readAt. |

## PlanRow

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string, not empty | yes |  | Row id: test type and atom id for a contract row, journey.N or pairwise.N otherwise. |
| `atomIds` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | Atoms the row exercises: the atom under test, then its skill or helper; a journey lists its path in order. |
| `cell` | map of string to string | yes |  | Dimension id to value id on the situation axes |
| `testType` | [TestType](#testtype) | yes |  | The test type the row asks for. |
| `mode` | [RunMode](#runmode) | yes |  | How the row runs: replay, unit or live, set by its test type. |
| `status` | one of `proposed`, `approved`, `struck` | no | `proposed` | Proposed until a person approves or strikes the row; generate skips struck rows. |
| `weight` | number, at least 0 | no | `1` | The share of the run budget the row gets, edited by hand. |
| `note` | string | no |  | What the row checks, in plain words. |

## TestType

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `obligation` | The required act happens, or a forbidden act does not, in the situation of the rule. |
| `outside_trigger` | Negative control: outside its situation the act does not happen, or an allowed act is not held back. |
| `twin` | The obligation again, with the ask put in another phrasing. |
| `ordered_pair` | The first act of a gate comes before the second. |
| `skip_pressure` | The owner pushes to go faster, and the order of the gate still holds. |
| `route_positive` | A positive ask loads the route target. |
| `route_near_miss` | Negative control: an ask close to the trigger that belongs elsewhere does not load the target. |
| `misroute` | The ask names the act without the skill; the right target loads, or the agent says why not. |
| `read_when` | The reference file is read at the moment named. |
| `script_fixture` | The script runs on a fixture, checked by its exit code and output. |
| `dispatch` | The helper dispatch carries every brief field the helper needs. |
| `contract_alone` | The helper runs alone: its typed output, and no act it must not do. |
| `stop_resume` | The helper stops mid-task and is resumed with its work intact. |
| `guard_positive` | A recorded event gives the guard verdict. |
| `guard_negative` | Negative control: a look-alike event leaves the guard silent. |
| `guard_hostile` | Malformed input gives no crash and a safe verdict. |
| `guard_speed` | The guard answers within its time budget. |
| `guard_register` | The guard message follows the output rules. |
| `tool_boundary` | Tool calls stay inside the schema and the permission rule. |
| `tool_denied` | A call the settings deny is never attempted. |
| `tool_deferred` | A deferred tool is loaded before its first use. |
| `stage_order` | The stage is reached in its order in the step list. |
| `stage_skip` | The owner pushes to go faster, and the stage is not skipped. |
| `stage_anytime` | A step allowed at any point shows once in the block, wherever, and is not required. |
| `register_sample` | A sample of replies to one ask class, judged and counted against the output rule. |
| `hazard_recovery` | The hazard during a long task: the agent recovers, edits nothing out of scope and loses no row. |
| `invariant` | A static test of the estate files, with no run. |
| `setting` | A static test that the settings still hold the key, and its value when kept. |
| `journey` | A path of atoms from the standing instructions over the estate graph, one block per atom. |

## RunMode

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `replay` | The row runs over a recorded session, offline, with no model call. |
| `unit` | The row runs offline on one piece of the estate, such as a guard, a script or a helper alone. |
| `live` | The row runs the agent headless in a sandboxed copy of the estate. |

## Plan summary

Counts and lists that describe the plan.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cells` | integer, at least 0 | yes |  | Distinct pairs of the atoms of a row and its situation values. |
| `coveringArraySize` | integer, at least 0 | yes |  | Rows of the pairwise covering array. |
| `perKind` | map of string to integer, at least 0 | yes |  | Contract rows per atom kind, a row counted once for each kind it names. |
| `perTestType` | map of string to integer, at least 0 | yes |  | Rows per test type across contract, journey and pairwise rows. |
| `unenforcedAtoms` | list of strings | yes |  | Ids of approved instruction, gate and register atoms that no guard enforces. |
| `cellsWithoutPhrase` | integer, at least 0 | yes |  | Cells with no approved phrase; the plan reads no phrase bank, so it equals cells. |
| `edgesWithoutJourney` | integer, at least 0 | yes |  | Journey edges that no journey takes. |

## Situation

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$` | yes |  | A short id, unique among the situations of the bank. |
| `title` | string, not empty | yes |  | What the situation is, in a few words. |
| `use` | [SituationUse](#situationuse) | yes |  | What the situation is for, such as setting the atom off or tempting the agent to skip a gate. |
| `atoms` | list of strings, each not empty, at least 1 item | yes |  | The atoms this situation exercises |
| `cell` | map of string to string | no |  | Situation axis values the phrases express; a plan row must agree with each of them |
| `workspace` | string matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$` | no |  | The workspace seed the ask starts from |
| `touches` | [Touches](#touches) | no |  | The workspace paths the ask may touch; every other path stays untouched |
| `phrases` | list of [BankPhrase](#bankphrase), at least 1 item | yes |  | The asks that put the agent in the situation, each approved or not. |

## SituationUse

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `trigger` | The situation sets the atom off. |
| `outside` | The situation sits just outside the atom's trigger, so the act must not happen. |
| `near_miss` | The situation reads like a route's asks but is not one. |
| `misroute` | The situation names the wrong primitive for the work. |
| `pressure` | The situation tempts the agent to skip a gate or a stage. |
| `resume` | The situation picks a stopped helper up again. |
| `forced` | The situation instructs the guarded act itself, so a live guard test never waits for the agent to choose it. |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, not empty | yes |  | The transcript's file name without .jsonl |
| `situation` | string matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$` | yes |  | The situation of the bank the session was recorded in. |
| `ask` | string, not empty | yes |  | The recorded ask: one approved phrase of the situation |
| `from_block` | integer, at least 0 | no | `0` | The session block a generated spec's first block replays from; 0 is the first block. |
| `violates` | list of strings, each not empty | no | `[]` | The atoms the session breaks: a spec on any of them is planned to fail |
| `note` | string | no |  | A free remark about the session, for a person; the generator does not read it. |
